description: Search Swiss addresses, places, municipalities and postal codes and return coordinates (WGS84 + LV95). Works with street addresses ('Bundesplatz 3 Bern'), place names ('Matterhorn'), and PLZ codes.

origins.description: Comma-separated source filter: address, zipcode, gg25 (municipalities), district, kantone, gazetteer. Default: all

query.description: Address, place name or postal code to search

name: geocode
title: Geocode a Swiss address or place
